anchor: Close-out checks confirm the optima are robust to the router's tuning knobs (35 corner re-runs; no frontier movement).
claim_text: Close-out checks (35 corner re-runs) confirm optima are robust to router tuning knobs with no frontier movement.

anchor: run through the same replay path in both its shipped load-based variant (A) and its SLA-target variant (B, ARIMA-driven throughput loop plus load loop).
claim_text: The reactive baseline has two variants: load-based (A) and SLA-target (B, ARIMA-driven throughput loop plus load loop).

anchor: the fair strawman is identically informed with the next chapter's predictive policy: the same worker-mapping law (workers = ceil(demand / ρ) at per-worker capacity rating ρ img/s, hysteresis 3 minutes, lead L), fed by the trailing window of the observed image rate --- the correct per-pool signal, observed not forecast.
claim_text: The reactive encoder strawman uses the same worker-mapping law as the predictive policy: workers = ceil(demand / ρ) with ρ=15 img/s, 3-minute hysteresis, lead L, fed by trailing window of observed image rate (observed, not forecast).

anchor: Measurement uses CUDA events around the full forward pass (patch input resident on GPU), bf16, 5 replications of 50 timed iterations each
claim_text: Measurement protocol: CUDA events, bf16, 5 replications × 50 iterations.

anchor: The controller is deliberately minimal, so any advantage traces to the information source, not control sophistication.
claim_text: The controller design is minimal to ensure any advantage comes from the forecast information source rather than control sophistication.

anchor: The raw head-to-head therefore bundles anticipation with headroom, and the two dials are separated by the p50-forecast, lead-invariance, and reactive-with-headroom ablations below.
claim_text: The forecast vs reactive comparison bundles anticipation and headroom; these are separated via p50-forecast, lead-invariance, and reactive-with-headroom ablations.

anchor: The trace's first 1.4 days are consumed as forecast context --- the zero-shot models' rolling history before their first usable 15-second forecast --- and never graded; the remaining 5.60 days form the evaluation span.
claim_text: Trace split: first 1.4 days used as forecast context (not graded), remaining 5.60 days form evaluation span.

anchor: The ledger is built on the five windows with a request-linked composed replay (aggregate, burst1, burst3, burst4, burst5), each with four policy arms (reactive and the three foundation-model forecasts), joined back to its run by exact artifact path --- 20 arms in total.
claim_text: Ledger: 5 windows x 4 policy arms = 20 request-linked composed arms.
